channel_send.hint: Goes out on {channel} first, as “من كور هب (your name): …”, then to the agent, which answers there. The reply shows here when the agent finishes.
channel_send.error_channel: {channel} refused the message, so it did not reach the agent: {message}
channel_send.status_posted: Posted on {channel} · waiting for the agent to take it
channel_send.status_delivered: With the agent · it answers when its current turn ends
channel_send.failed_bridge_no_answer: Posted on {channel}, but Hermes did not take it in time (its messaging gateway may be restarting). Sending again posts it on {channel} again.
channel_send.failed_not_accepted: Posted on {channel}, but Hermes refused to hand it to the agent.
channel_send.failed_not_picked_up: Posted on {channel}, but the agent never picked it up. Hermes’s log says why.
channel_send.unavailable_not_admin: A conversation from {channel}. Only an admin can write into it from here; replies are made in {channel}.
channel_send.unavailable_platform_unsupported: A conversation from {channel} — read-only here for now. Writing from Core Hub works for Telegram and WhatsApp.
channel_send.unavailable_hermes_not_managed: A conversation from {channel} — read-only: this hub does not run Hermes, so it cannot write into it.
channel_send.unavailable_bridge_offline: A conversation from {channel} — writing from here is unavailable while Hermes’s messaging gateway is starting or stopped.
channel_send.unavailable_not_current: This {channel} chat has moved on to a newer conversation; a message from here would go there.
channel_send.unavailable_no_route: A conversation from {channel} — Hermes keeps no way back to this chat, so it cannot be written into from here.
